candidate.name: CPLG-SGD
candidate.control: memoryless outer SGD with exact f32 learning-rate bits 0x3e8f5c29 and positive-zero momentum bits 0x00000000
candidate.treatment: online CPLG-SGD-v1 with the frozen three-positive causal interlock

prerequisite_evidence.accepted_claim: fresh stock-only off-policy directional and capture-engineering screen
prerequisite_evidence.forbidden_use: R2 model state, tape vectors, losses, actions, and bootstrap samples are prerequisite evidence only and may not be inputs to, controls for, or tuning data for active E1

source.active_e1_commit_binding: unknown until a clean pushed implementation commit is independently pinned by the future immutable cloud acquisition spec

cpu_analysis.execution: separate pinned local or zero-accelerator CPU environment after verified GPU teardown

mechanism.arithmetic: left-to-right sequential f32 with separate products and sums; no FMA
mechanism.authoritative_transcendentals: Rust libm 0.2.15 atan2f, sinf, and cosf through a hash-pinned helper
mechanism.rho_contract: finite acute nonstationary 0 < rho < 1 with dot overshoot tolerance 2^-20
mechanism.interlock: select the current nonstock candidate only when the newest three already-resolved same-fragment f32 scores are all strictly positive
causal_state_per_fragment: the newest at most three resolved f32 scores

action_contract.candidate_selected: used_nonstock is true, action SHA-256 equals candidate SHA-256, and action SHA-256 differs from stock SHA-256
action_contract.all_fallbacks: used_nonstock is false and the selected action is the original stock byte object with action SHA-256 exactly equal to stock SHA-256
action_contract.zero_or_rounded_phase: seal the original stock byte object as the pending candidate; its later exact +0.0 score closes the strict-positive interlock
action_contract.clearing: nonfinite, degenerate, nonacute, invalid geometry, or invalid shadow evidence returns exact stock and clears the complete affected-fragment causal state

mechanism.preview_commit_contract: preview is pure and commit installs exactly one preview once

workload.freshness: each arm starts from the same separately restored initial model, adapter, optimizer, data-order, and RNG state; neither arm resumes or consumes the other arm
workload.scheduler: linear warmup for 10 optimizer steps, then constant

activity.denominator: all 32 predefined candidate-arm commit boundaries; no row is removed for warm-up, clearing, fallback, malformed evidence, or tail state
activity.action_indicator: cplg_used_nonstock is true and the action/candidate/stock hash contract is satisfied
activity.fragment_indicator: a fragment is active when at least one of its eight predefined boundaries has a valid nonstock selected action

loss.source: unrounded finite binary64 eval_loss values from the closed three-row results.jsonl
loss.untrained_base: report-only and not substituted for the stock control
loss.claim: noncatastrophic short-work engineering regression screen, not a superiority test

overhead.interval_start: after complete global f32 state initialization and identity hashing, immediately before opening the commit scheduling loop
overhead.interval_end: after commit 32 and durable closure of that arm's event/action evidence; model loading, input hashing, export, and terminal evaluation are outside both intervals
overhead.computed_by: separate CPU analysis from the two exact integer intervals

gates.pass_rule: all provenance, freshness, exact-work, finite-loss, action/fallback, activity, regression, overhead, artifact, and phase-separation gates pass
gates.fail_rule: complete identifiable valid evidence misses any scientific or engineering gate

artifacts.prefix_rule: fresh distinct immutable prefixes; CPU analysis may read but never modify the acquisition prefix
gpu_acquisition_required: immutable future cloud spec and rendered command
source, image, runtime, model, data, and scientific-config provenance
stock and candidate final syncer checkpoints
stock and candidate learner, syncer, and export logs
stock and candidate exported adapter trees
matched initial-state, schedule, responder, local-step, token, commit, and fragment-order receipts
candidate CPLG action/fallback fields and closed reason codes at all 32 boundaries
exact stock and candidate monotonic interval receipts
GPU acquisition completion receipt with scientific_verdict null
one canonical acquisition manifest covering every required acquisition object
cpu_analysis_required: round-trip verification of every acquisition-manifest object

lifecycle.gpu_success: continuously sync, close and locally verify the acquisition manifest, final-sync, controller-side round-trip verify from GCS, exact-ID delete the A100 VM and auto-delete disk, prove both absent, then start CPU analysis
lifecycle.gpu_incomplete: stop work, preserve available evidence, exact-ID abandon with a concrete reason, and prove VM and disk absence; do not manufacture a scientific verdict from incomplete acquisition
lifecycle.pass: no retry; report only a short-work active engineering canary pass and require a separately reviewed higher-work or same-state CRN protocol for any stronger claim
lifecycle.fail: no retry; kill CPLG-SGD-v1 at active E1 under the frozen gate
lifecycle.inconclusive: no automatic retry; preserve evidence and require a newly reviewed protocol and fresh identity
lifecycle.unidentifiable: no retry under this protocol; require a new evidence design and fresh identity
lifecycle.infra_failure: at most one fresh-identity retry with identical scientific semantics after evidence preservation, exact-ID teardown, and documented root-cause repair
lifecycle.cpu_analysis_failure: retry only the pinned zero-accelerator analysis from the same verified acquisition manifest; never retain, resume, or relaunch the A100 for CPU-only work
lifecycle.every_attempt: never mutate unrelated resources; record exact VM, disk, image, ownership nonce, artifact prefixes, sync verification, teardown, and provider absence evidence

claim_boundary.pass_claim: CPLG-SGD-v1 was active across the frozen 4,352-token short matched online workload, retained exact stock fallback, stayed within the absolute 0.05 terminal-loss regression and 2% matched-interval overhead limits, and completed the engineering artifact contract
forbidden_claims: population, seed, model, H, learner-count, or inner-optimizer generalization
authorization for E2 or production replacement
